name: Trading 212 Sync
description: Sync your Trading 212 investment account (trades, dividends, deposits, withdrawals, fees and interest) into Wealthfolio, directly from the Trading 212 API.
author: dpremoli

permissions.purpose: Find or create the Wealthfolio securities account (and optional card cash account) for each Trading 212 account
Import Trading 212 trades, dividends and cash movements as activities, skip duplicates, and clear them when the tracking mode changes
Write current positions and cash as a holdings snapshot for HOLDINGS-mode accounts
Match Trading 212 tickers and ISINs to Wealthfolio symbols
Store each Trading 212 API key ID and secret in the keyring and let the host attach it to Trading 212 requests; also moves v1.x settings out of the keyring
When card extraction is on, create rules that file Trading 212 card spending under the matching Wealthfolio spending categories
Call the Trading 212 API (*.trading212.com) and download its signed CSV exports from cloud storage (*.amazonaws.com)
Trigger a background refresh of already-synced accounts when Wealthfolio refreshes its portfolio
Show the Trading 212 dashboard and settings pages
